query: WITH done AS (UPDATE ops.alert a SET resolved_at = $2 WHERE a.id = $1 AND a.resolved_at IS NULL AND a.kind <> $3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.alert_push p WHERE p.alert_id = a.id) RETURNING a.id) INSERT INTO ops.alert_ack (alert_id, acknowledged_by, at) SELECT id, 'casey', $2 FROM done RETURNING alert_id
